Fixtures for the Anton Art Center connector.

- calendar.json: the Events Calendar widget's public JSON in the shape observed on 2026-10-11 (inffuse.eventscalendar.co ... /data/public/events). It holds the 13 current/upcoming entries seen that day (titles, dates, flags, hours and locations as observed; the Afternoon at the Anton and Altar Making descriptions carry the observed text that disagrees with / replaces the structured fields) plus two past entries. Descriptions elsewhere are placeholders. The real feed has 558 entries back to 2015.
- exhibits.html, post-*.html: minimized pages rebuilt from the observed markup of theartcenter.org/exhibits and its /single-post/ pages (og: meta tags, the data-hook post-description block, the repeated date line, gallery line, "---" rules, program and hours sections). Titles and date ranges are the real ones; body text is illustrative, not copied.
- generated by a throwaway script, not by the crawler; edit by hand if the site's structure changes.
